messages.content: You are helping build a small inventory of general ideas that English words carry. Answer with JSON only, in the schema you are given.

For each word below, name the broad, reusable ideas it carries.

An idea is a broad, reusable category that many different words share, like health, money, speed,
danger, family, food, person, place, action or feeling. It is never a definition of the word and
never a synonym of it.

The approved inventory is below. Prefer these exact names whenever they plausibly fit:
- transportation: moves people or things from place to place
- vehicle: a thing you ride in or on that moves
- machine: has an engine or motor and works by itself
- control: someone steers, drives or operates it
- people: carries, holds or serves many people
- person: is a human being
- animal: is an animal
- living: is alive
- plant: is a plant or comes from one
- food: is eaten
- drink: is drunk
- place: is somewhere you can go
- building: is a building
- home: belongs in or is a home
- nature: is part of the outdoors
- water: has to do with water
- sky: is up in the sky
- road: has to do with roads and paths
- weather: is weather
- tool: is used by hand to do a job
- container: holds things inside
- clothing: is worn
- body: is part of a body
- health: has to do with being well or sick
- danger: can hurt you
- fire: burns or has fire
- energy: powers things
- electricity: uses or makes electricity
- money: is money or is about money
- work: has to do with jobs
- learning: helps you learn
- communication: carries messages
- sound: makes sound
- music: makes music
- light: gives light
- time: tells or measures time
- play: is for fun
- sport: is a sport or for sport
- emotion: is a feeling
- family: is family
- child: is young
- speed: is fast
- heavy: is heavy
- small: is small
- sharp: is sharp
- soft: is soft
- hot: is hot
- cold: is cold
- metal: is made of metal
- wood: is made of wood
- art: is art or made to be looked at

Rules:
- Give 1 to 3 ideas per word, most important first.
- Usually use approved ideas. Invent a new idea only when the word's core ordinary meaning is not
  represented above.
- A new idea must be broad enough to fit at least 8 different words in a 2,500-word vocabulary.
  If it mainly fits this word, one word family, or one narrow object, do not invent it.
- Use one shared name for related meanings. Do not create near-synonyms or grammatical variants.
- Each idea is one lowercase English word, or two joined by an underscore. No spaces, no phrases.
- Reuse the same idea name across words wherever it fits. That is the whole point.
- Return every word below, exactly once, spelled exactly as given, in the same order.

Words:
abandon
abandonment
able
abrupt
absolutely
abstract
accent
accept
acceptable
access
accessibility
accessible
accessory
account
accountability
accuracy
ache
achieve
acknowledge
acorn
